mainTopic: Why an אשם brought inside stays כשר, what the comparisons of מנחה and אשם to חטאת teach, and offerings slaughtered as a פסח.
overview: The גמרא first tries to prove by logic that an אשם whose blood was brought inside the היכל stays כשר. It uses עולה and מנחת חוטא, and finally a הצד השוה of both, but each proof is knocked down, the last one by רבא מברניש. So the גמרא concludes that the רבנן learn it from the word 'דמה': only a חטאת becomes פסול this way. It then shows how רבי אליעזר and the רבנן each use that word. Next, it asks what the comparison of a מנחה to both a חטאת and an אשם teaches each side. For the רבנן it teaches about שלא לשמה, and for רבי אליעזר it teaches רבי שמעון's rule about the right hand and a כלי שרת. For the רבנן, the comparison of אשם to חטאת teaches סמיכה. Finally, רבי יוחנן and רבה discuss how far יוסף בן חוני agrees with רבי אליעזר, and a ברייתא brings the debate between רבי אליעזר and רבי יהושע about other offerings slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th. That debate continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A קל וחומר from the burnt offering
steps.stepSummary: If an עולה, which is burned completely, stays כשר when its blood goes inside, then an אשם, which is not burned completely, should certainly stay כשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: An עולה is totally burned on the מזבח, and still, if its blood went inside, it is כשר. An אשם is not totally burned, so surely it is כשר too!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is continuing its search for a source that an אשם whose blood went inside stays כשר, and offers a קל וחומר from עולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An עולה is כליל, completely given to the מזבח, so it seems the more holy and strict קרבן. If even the stricter עולה is not disqualified by its blood going inside, the less strict אשם should not be disqualified either.

keyTerms.meaning: Burnt offering, burned entirely on the מזבח
Entirely consumed on the מזבח
Inside, into the היכל
Guilt offering
All the more so (a קל וחומר)

phrases.english: A burnt offering, which is entirely consumed,
if its blood entered inside, it is fit;
phrases.notes: "Inside" means into the היכל, the inner building, instead of staying out in the courtyard where it belongs.

phrases.english: a guilt offering, which is not entirely consumed,
is it not all the more so?!

steps.triggerLanguage: עוֹלָה שֶׁהִיא כָּלִיל, נִכְנַס דָּמָהּ לִפְנִים כְּשֵׁרָה; אָשָׁם שֶׁאֵינוֹ כָּלִיל, לֹא כׇּל שֶׁכֵּן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the search, begun before this section, for a source that an אשם brought inside stays כשר.
steps.raayaObject: That an אשם whose blood entered the היכל remains כשר.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from עולה, which is כליל yet stays כשר when its blood goes inside.

steps.title: The burnt offering does not atone
steps.stepSummary: The קל וחומר is broken: an עולה has a leniency of its own, since it does not come to atone for a sin.
steps.simpleTranslation: What about an עולה? It is different, because it does not bring כפרה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא knocks down the קל וחומר by showing a way the עולה is more lenient than the אשם.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A קל וחומר only works if the source case is stricter in every way that matters. An אשם atones for a sin and an עולה does not. Maybe a קרבן that brings כפרה is stricter and does become פסול when its blood goes inside.

keyTerms.meaning: What about...? (opening of a challenge to a קל וחומר)
Since, because (it has this special feature)
Atones, brings כפרה

phrases.english: What about a burnt offering?
It is different, since it does not atone!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the קל וחומר of step 1.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the קל וחומר from עולה alone.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The עולה does not bring כפרה, so it may be more lenient than the אשם, which does.

steps.title: The sinner's meal offering proves the point
steps.stepSummary: The proof is rescued: מנחת חוטא does bring כפרה, and it still does not become פסול by going inside.
steps.simpleTranslation: The מנחת חוטא will prove it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by pointing to a different קרבן that does atone.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The objection said maybe atoning קרבנות are stricter. מנחת חוטא atones and yet is not made פסול by entering inside, so atoning cannot be the reason for disqualifying. Together, עולה and מנחת חוטא cover each other's weak points.

keyTerms.meaning: The flour offering a poor sinner brings instead of an animal
Will prove (it serves as evidence)

phrases.english: The meal offering of a sinner will prove it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 2.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Counter-example that removes the distinction raised by the objection.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Maybe a קרבן that atones becomes פסול when brought inside.
steps.terutzMaskana: מנחת חוטא atones and still stays כשר inside, so atoning is not a reason for פסול.
steps.whatToRemember: The proof for אשם stands on two legs: עולה (stricter because כליל) and מנחת חוטא (atones, yet stays כשר inside).

steps.title: Why not use the bird sin offering?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why it did not use חטאת העוף, which atones and also has blood like an אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let us say instead that the חטאת העוף will prove it!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא stops to ask why it picked מנחת חוטא when a closer example seems to be available. This sets up the next answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: חטאת העוף atones like an אשם and, unlike a flour offering, has blood. So it would be a closer and better comparison for an אשם whose blood went inside.

keyTerms.meaning: But let us say
A sin offering of a bird

phrases.english: But let us say: the bird sin offering will prove it!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the choice of מנחת חוטא in step 3.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the גמרא did not use חטאת העוף, a closer example with blood, as the proof.

steps.title: The bird sin offering is an open question
steps.stepSummary: חטאת העוף cannot be used, because whether it becomes פסול when brought inside is an unresolved question asked by רבי אבין.
steps.simpleTranslation: חטאת העוף is the subject of רבי אבין's unanswered question.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why it could not use חטאת העוף as its proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: You can only prove something from a case whose law is known for sure. Since רבי אבין asked whether a חטאת העוף brought inside is פסול, its law is uncertain, so the גמרא had to use מנחת חוטא instead.

keyTerms.meaning: An open question, a dilemma

phrases.aramaic: חַטַּאת הָעוֹף – בַּעְיָא דְּרַבִּי אָבִין הִיא.
phrases.english: The bird sin offering is the subject of a dilemma of Rabbi Avin.

steps.triggerLanguage: חַטַּאת הָעוֹף – בַּעְיָא דְּרַבִּי אָבִין הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 4.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The law of a חטאת העוף brought inside is itself uncertain (רבי אבין's question), so it cannot serve as proof.
steps.whatToRemember: A proof must come from a case whose law is certain; an unresolved בעיא cannot be used as evidence.
steps.confusionAlert: The גמרא is not saying חטאת העוף stays כשר or becomes פסול inside. It is only saying we don't know yet.

steps.title: The sinner's meal offering is not an animal offering
steps.stepSummary: The proof from מנחת חוטא is broken, because it is not a זבח (a slaughtered animal offering) like an אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: But we can still knock this down: a מנחת חוטא is different, because it is not a slaughtered animal offering at all!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the rescue from Step 3. It says a מנחת חוטא is too different from an אשם to prove anything.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In Step 3, מנחת חוטא was used because, like an אשם, it brings כפרה. Now the גמרא points out a new difference: a מנחת חוטא is made of flour and has no blood, while an אשם is an animal with blood. Maybe the rule about blood going inside is only lenient for things that are not a זבח.

keyTerms.meaning: But let us refute: the opening word for pointing out a weakness in a קל וחומר
A sinner's meal offering, a flour offering brought by a poor person for certain sins
A type of slaughtered animal offering

phrases.english: But let us refute: what about a sinner's meal offering?
It is different, since it is not a type of slaughtered offering!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלִפְרוֹךְ: מָה לְמִנְחַת חוֹטֵא, שֶׁכֵּן אֵינָהּ מִין זֶבַח
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the חטאת העוף side discussion of Steps 4-5 and attacks the מנחת חוטא proof from Step 3.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof from מנחת חוטא alone.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: מנחת חוטא is not a זבח, so it may have a leniency an animal offering like אשם does not have.

steps.title: Combining the burnt offering and the sinner's meal offering
steps.stepSummary: The עולה answers the weakness of מנחת חוטא, so the גמרא builds a הצד השוה from both: they are קדשי קדשים and stay כשר when brought inside, so an אשם should too.
steps.simpleTranslation: The עולה proves the point, since it is an animal offering and still stays כשר. So the argument comes back around: each one has its own weakness, but what they share is that both are קדשי קדשים and both stay כשר when brought inside. So too an אשם, which is also קדשי קדשים, should stay כשר when its blood goes inside.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rescues the proof by joining the two earlier sources together. Each source covers the gap in the other one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The עולה alone was rejected because it does not bring כפרה (Step 2), and the מנחת חוטא alone was rejected because it is not a זבח (Step 6). But the עולה is a זבח and the מנחת חוטא does bring כפרה, so neither weakness can explain the rule. What is left in common is that both are קדשי קדשים, and an אשם is קדשי קדשים too.

keyTerms.meaning: Will prove it: one case is brought to show that the objection does not matter
And the reasoning comes back around to where it started
The feature of this one is not like the feature of that one: each source has its own weakness
The shared element: what two sources have in common, used to prove a third case
Offerings of the highest holiness
Inside, meaning into the היכל

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think the עולה and מנחת חוטא are being proven to be the same. The point is the opposite: they are different, but each one covers the other's weakness, and the feature they share is what makes the proof work.

phrases.english: A burnt offering can prove it.
And the reasoning has come back around;
the feature of this one is not like the feature of that one,
and the feature of that one is not like the feature of this one;
the shared element in them is:
that they are offerings of the highest holiness,
and if (their blood) entered inside, they are still fit;
phrases.notes: Some versions leave out the word in round brackets. A מנחת חוטא has no blood anyway.

phrases.english: so too, I will bring in a guilt offering,
which is an offering of the highest holiness,
and if its blood entered inside, it is fit.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the objection of Step 6 by joining the עולה from Step 1 with the מנחת חוטא from Step 3.
steps.terutzResolutionType: הצד השוה: two sources combined so that each one cancels the other's weakness
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The proof seemed lost, since each source on its own had a weakness.
steps.terutzMaskana: Together, the shared feature of קדשי קדשים proves that an אשם stays כשר when its blood goes inside.

steps.title: The guilt offering has a fixed value
steps.stepSummary: רבא מברניש breaks the הצד השוה: עולה and מנחת חוטא both have no fixed value, but an אשם does, so maybe that is why they are lenient.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא מברניש said to רב אשי: But we can knock this down too. The shared element of עולה and מנחת חוטא is that neither has a fixed value. Can you then say the same about an אשם, which does have a fixed value?
steps.whatsHappening: רבא מברניש finds a second thing the עולה and מנחת חוטא share, which the אשם does not have. This breaks the הצד השוה proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A הצד השוה only works if the shared feature that is being used is the only one that matters. Here there is another shared feature: neither the עולה nor the מנחת חוטא has a set price. An אשם does have a set price, so maybe it is stricter and becomes פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: רבא from the town of ברניש, who asks this to רב אשי
A fixed amount, here a set value that the offering must be worth
Can you say? This asks whether the rule can really be carried over to the new case

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא מִבַּרְנִישׁ לְרַב אָשֵׁי:
phrases.english: Rava of Barnish said to Rav Ashi:
But let us refute: what about their shared element?
It is different, since they have no fixed value;
can you say the same about a guilt offering, which has a fixed value?!

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא מִבַּרְנִישׁ לְרַב אָשֵׁי: וְלִפְרוֹךְ, מָה לְהַצַּד הַשָּׁוֶה שֶׁבָּהֶן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the הצד השוה built in Step 7.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole הצד השוה proof from עולה and מנחת חוטא.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: Both sources share another lenient feature, having no fixed value, which the אשם does not share.

steps.title: The real reason of the Rabbis comes from the word 'its blood'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives up on logic proofs. The רבנן learn it from the פסוק: 'דמה', meaning only the blood of a חטאת becomes פסול inside, not the blood of any other offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, this is the reason of the רבנן: the פסוק says 'its blood', which means the blood of this offering, the חטאת, and not the blood of another offering.
steps.whatsHappening: After all the logic proofs failed, the גמרא says the רבנן's view actually comes from a word in the תורה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק about a חטאת whose blood was brought inside says 'דמה', its blood. The extra focus on 'its' limits the rule of becoming פסול to a חטאת only. So an אשם, and any other offering, stays כשר even if its blood goes inside, with no need for a קל וחומר or הצד השוה.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather: drops the earlier approach and brings a new one
This is their reason
The פסוק
Its blood, the word in the פסוק that limits the rule to a חטאת

steps.whatToRemember: Every logic proof (קל וחומר from עולה, from מנחת חוטא, and the הצד השוה) was knocked down. The רבנן's real source is the word 'דמה': only a חטאת becomes פסול when its blood is brought inside.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows why a פסוק was needed: logic alone could not prove that an אשם stays כשר, because each comparison had a weakness.

phrases.english: Rather, this is the reason of the Rabbis,
as the verse says: "its blood"
phrases.notes: ויקרא 6:23

phrases.aramaic: דָּמָהּ שֶׁל זוֹ, וְלָא דָּמָהּ שֶׁל אַחֵר.
phrases.english: the blood of this one, and not the blood of another.
phrases.notes: 'This one' is the חטאת the פסוק is talking about.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא הַיְינוּ טַעְמַיְיהוּ דְּרַבָּנַן, דְּאָמַר קְרָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Since Step 8 broke the last logic proof, the גמרא replaces the whole approach with a פסוק.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The רבנן hold an אשם stays כשר when its blood goes inside because 'דמה' limits becoming פסול this way to a חטאת alone.

steps.title: How רבי אליעזר uses the word 'דמה'
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר does not use 'דמה' to leave out the אשם. He uses it to teach that only the blood of a חטאת becomes פסול inside, not its meat.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the other one, רבי אליעזר: 'its blood' means its blood, but not its meat.
steps.whatsHappening: The רבנן used 'דמה' to teach that an אשם's blood stays כשר inside. So the גמרא asks what רבי אליעזר, who disagrees with them, does with that word, and it answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Every word in the תורה must teach something, so רבי אליעזר also needs a use for 'דמה'. He reads it as 'its blood, not its meat': if the meat of a חטאת is brought inside the היכל, it does not become פסול. Only the blood does.

keyTerms.meaning: And the other one: the other side of the argument
Its blood (ויקרא 6:23)
Its meat

phrases.english: And the other one?
phrases.notes: This means רבי אליעזר. The question 'what does he do with this word?' is understood, not spoken.

phrases.english: 'Its blood', and not its meat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Step 9 showed how the רבנן use 'דמה'. This step gives רבי אליעזר's use of the same word.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What does רבי אליעזר learn from 'דמה', since he does not use it to leave out the אשם?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He learns that only the blood of a חטאת becomes פסול inside, not its meat.

steps.title: The רבנן learn both lessons from 'דמה' instead of 'דם'
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן also need a source that the meat does not become פסול. They learn it because the פסוק wrote 'דמה' (its blood) when it could have just written 'דם' (blood).
steps.simpleTranslation: And the other ones, the רבנן, learn it from the change from 'blood' to 'its blood'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now turns to the רבנן. They used 'דמה' to leave out the אשם, so where do they learn that the meat of a חטאת does not become פסול? The גמרא answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק could have said just 'דם'. The extra letter ה, making it 'דמה', gives the רבנן room for a second lesson. So one word teaches two things: other offerings are left out, and the meat is left out.

keyTerms.meaning: Blood, the shorter word the פסוק could have used

phrases.english: And the other ones?
phrases.notes: Now it means the רבנן: where do they learn that the meat is not פסול?

phrases.english: From 'blood' to 'its blood'.
phrases.notes: The פסוק could have said 'blood' but said 'its blood'. The extra letter gives the second lesson.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After seeing רבי אליעזר's use of 'דמה', the גמרא asks how the רבנן cover his lesson about the meat.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Where do the רבנן learn that the meat of a חטאת is not פסול when brought inside?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: From the extra letter: the פסוק wrote 'דמה' instead of 'דם'.

steps.title: Why רבי אליעזר does not learn from 'דם' versus 'דמה'
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר does not read any lesson into the change from 'דם' to 'דמה'. So he has only one lesson from that word: the meat is left out.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the other one, רבי אליעזר, does not learn anything from the change from 'blood' to 'its blood'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why רבי אליעזר cannot also learn the אשם lesson from the word, the way the רבנן do. He simply does not read meaning into that change.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The whole difference comes down to one point: does the extra letter ה teach anything? The רבנן say yes, so they get two lessons. רבי אליעזר says no, so 'דמה' teaches him only one thing, and the אשם is not left out.

keyTerms.meaning: He does not learn a lesson from it

steps.whatToRemember: The argument about an אשם brought inside comes down to the word 'דמה'. The רבנן learn two lessons from it (not the meat, and not other offerings). רבי אליעזר learns only one (not the meat).

phrases.english: And the other one,
does not learn anything from 'blood' versus 'its blood'.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains why רבי אליעזר does not accept the two-lesson reading the רבנן gave in step 11.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why doesn't רבי אליעזר learn the אשם lesson from the extra letter too?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He does not learn anything from the change from 'דם' to 'דמה'.

steps.title: For the רבנן, comparing a מנחה to both a חטאת and an אשם makes sense
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא goes back to the argument in the משנה about an אשם slaughtered שלא לשמו. It starts a 'בשלמא' setup: according to the רבנן, who say that אשם is כשר, it makes sense that the תורה compares a מנחה to both a חטאת and an אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: It works well for the רבנן, who say an אשם slaughtered for the wrong purpose is כשר. That is why a מנחה is compared to a חטאת, and a מנחה is also compared to an אשם.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a challenge. It first says what makes sense for the רבנן, so it can then ask how רבי אליעזר explains the same פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the רבנן, a חטאת and an אשם follow different rules when slaughtered שלא לשמו: the חטאת is פסול and the אשם is כשר. So it makes sense for the פסוק to compare a מנחה to both of them. The word 'בשלמא' signals that a question against רבי אליעזר, who treats an אשם like a חטאת, is coming next.

keyTerms.meaning: It works well (for this side), opening a 'but for the other side...' question
For the wrong purpose, not for the offering's own sake
Was compared through a הקש, a comparison set up by a פסוק
Meal offering

steps.confusionAlert: This step is not a complete argument. 'בשלמא' only gives the side that works. The actual challenge to רבי אליעזר comes in the next lines.

phrases.english: It works well for the רבנן, who say:
an אשם that one slaughtered for the wrong purpose is כשר;
that is why a מנחה is compared to a חטאת,
phrases.notes: ויקרא 6:10: 'it is most holy, like the חטאת and like the אשם.'

phrases.english: and a מנחה to an אשם.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After closing the discussion of 'דמה', the גמרא returns to the main argument in the משנה about an אשם slaughtered שלא לשמו.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר, who says an אשם slaughtered שלא לשמו is פסול like a חטאת
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If a חטאת and an אשם follow the same rule, why would the פסוק compare a מנחה to both? The double comparison fits the רבנן, who see them as different. This step gives only that first half.

steps.title: רבי שמעון's ברייתא: a sinner's מנחה is like a חטאת, a voluntary מנחה is like an אשם
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to show why the comparison works for the רבנן. A sinner's מנחה is like a חטאת, so taking its handful שלא לשמה makes it פסול. A voluntary מנחה is like an אשם, so taking its handful שלא לשמה leaves it כשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: As a ברייתא teaches: רבי שמעון says: 'It is most holy, like the חטאת and like the אשם.' A sinner's מנחה is like a חטאת, so if the handful was taken not for its sake, it is פסול. A voluntary מנחה is like an אשם, so if the handful was taken not for its sake, it is כשר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing the 'בשלמא' setup from the last step. It quotes a ברייתא showing exactly what the comparison teaches according to the רבנן. This prepares the question about רבי אליעזר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק compares a מנחה to two different קרבנות, and רבי שמעון splits it. A sinner's מנחה follows the חטאת and is פסול שלא לשמה. A voluntary מנחה follows the אשם and stays כשר. This only works if an אשם שלא לשמו is כשר, which is the view of the רבנן.

keyTerms.meaning: A sinner's meal offering, brought for certain sins
A voluntary meal offering
He took its handful (the קומץ), a main service of a מנחה
Not for its own sake, with the wrong intention

steps.confusionAlert: Both kinds of מנחה are compared to the same פסוק, but each one follows a different קרבן. The sinner's מנחה follows the חטאת, and the voluntary מנחה follows the אשם.

phrases.english: As it is taught in a ברייתא: Rabbi Shimon says:
'It is most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering'
phrases.notes: ויקרא 6:10

phrases.english: A sinner's meal offering is like a sin offering;
therefore, if he took its handful not for its sake, it is disqualified.
A voluntary meal offering is like a guilt offering;
therefore, if he took its handful not for its sake, it is fit.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the source for the 'בשלמא' claim in step 13: according to the רבנן, the comparison has a clear meaning.
steps.raayaObject: That according to the רבנן, the comparison of a מנחה to both a חטאת and an אשם teaches something real
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא of רבי שמעון reading ויקרא 6:10

steps.title: For רבי אליעזר, what does the comparison teach?
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר holds that an אשם שלא לשמו is פסול, just like a חטאת. If so, the comparison of a מנחה to both seems to teach nothing new.
steps.simpleTranslation: But according to רבי אליעזר, for what הלכה is a מנחה compared to a חטאת and a מנחה compared to an אשם?
steps.whatsHappening: This is the punch of the 'בשלמא' setup. The גמרא asks why רבי אליעזר needs the comparison at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי אליעזר, a חטאת and an אשם are the same when brought שלא לשמו: both are פסול. So splitting a מנחה between them, as רבי שמעון did, gives no different result. The two-part comparison seems useless for him.

keyTerms.meaning: For what halacha? What is it teaching us?
Is compared through a היקש (a comparison the תורה makes)

phrases.english: But according to Rabbi Eliezer,
for what halacha is it compared:
a meal offering to a sin offering, and a meal offering to a guilt offering?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the 'בשלמא... אלא' structure that began in step 13.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר's view that an אשם שלא לשמו is פסול
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If a חטאת and an אשם are both פסול שלא לשמו, comparing a מנחה to each one separately teaches nothing, so the פסוק's double comparison has no purpose.

steps.title: The comparison teaches רבי שמעון's other lesson: a מנחה without a כלי שרת
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that for רבי אליעזר the comparison teaches a different lesson of רבי שמעון. It connects to a משנה where רבי שמעון says a מנחה is כשר even when not brought in a כלי שרת.
steps.simpleTranslation: It teaches the other lesson of רבי שמעון. As we learned in a משנה: if it was not done with a כלי שרת, it is פסול, and רבי שמעון says it is כשר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question. It says the comparison is used for a different הלכה from רבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: So the comparison is not wasted for רבי אליעזר. It is used for a different topic: how the service of a מנחה may be done, with or without a vessel. The next step explains how the פסוק teaches this.

keyTerms.meaning: For that other (lesson)
Holy vessels used for the Temple service
Rules it כשר (valid)

phrases.english: For that other lesson of Rabbi Shimon,
as we learned in a משנה: if not in a service vessel, it is disqualified.
And Rabbi Shimon deems it fit.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 15 by moving the comparison to a different halacha.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reassigns the פסוק to a different lesson
steps.terutzHavaAmina: For רבי אליעזר, the comparison of a מנחה to a חטאת and an אשם has no use.
steps.terutzMaskana: It teaches רבי שמעון's הלכה about doing the service of a מנחה with or without a כלי שרת.

steps.title: רב יהודה explains: by hand, use the right like a חטאת; with a כלי, the left is fine like an אשם
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה בריה דרבי חייא gives רבי שמעון's source. If the מנחה is done by hand, it must be the right hand, like a חטאת. If it is done with a vessel, even the left hand is fine, like an אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יהודה, son of רבי חייא, said: What is רבי שמעון's reason? The פסוק says: 'It is most holy, like the חטאת and like the אשם.' If he comes to do it by hand, he does it with the right hand, like a חטאת. If he does it with a vessel, he may do it with the left hand, like an אשם.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings רב יהודה to show how the פסוק teaches רבי שמעון's lesson. This fills in the answer from the last step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק gives two ways to do the service of a מנחה. Done by hand, it follows the חטאת and needs the right hand. Done with a vessel, it follows the אשם and the left hand is allowed. So for רבי אליעזר, the double comparison is about which hand and whether a vessel is used, not about שלא לשמה.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?
By hand, without a vessel
With the right hand
With the left hand

steps.whatToRemember: For the רבנן, the comparison of a מנחה to a חטאת and an אשם teaches about שלא לשמה. For רבי אליעזר, it teaches רבי שמעון's rule: by hand, use the right hand like a חטאת; with a vessel, even the left hand works, like an אשם.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows how the same פסוק can carry different lessons depending on each תנא's other views. It closes the question raised in step 13.

phrases.aramaic: וְאָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי חִיָּיא:
phrases.english: And Rav Yehuda, son of Rabbi Ḥiyya, said:
What is the reason of Rabbi Shimon?

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר קְרָא: ״קֹדֶשׁ קֳדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וּכְאָשָׁם״ –
phrases.english: The verse says: 'It is most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering'

phrases.aramaic: בָּא לְעוֹבְדָהּ בַּיָּד, עוֹבְדָהּ בַּיָּמִין כַּחַטָּאת;
phrases.english: if he comes to do it by hand, he does it with the right hand, like a sin offering;
with a vessel, he may do it with the left hand, like a guilt offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי חִיָּיא: מַאי טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains how the פסוק teaches רבי שמעון's rule that was named in step 16, which completes the answer.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A מנחה done by hand needs the right hand, like a חטאת. Done with a vessel, it may be done with the left hand, like an אשם.

steps.title: Can רבי שמעון use one verse for two lessons?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how רבי שמעון can learn two different laws from the same comparison of a מנחה to a חטאת and an אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי שמעון: does he use this verse for this lesson and also use it for that lesson?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer from steps 16-17. רבי שמעון seems to be getting two separate lessons out of one comparison.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 17, רבי שמעון used the comparison to teach the right-hand rule and the vessel rule. But רבי שמעון also holds that a sinner's מנחה is פסול שלא לשמה, which in step 14 came from the same comparison to a חטאת. One comparison normally can't be stretched to teach both lessons.

keyTerms.meaning: He takes it out, meaning he learns a lesson from it
For this purpose
Verse

phrases.english: And Rabbi Shimon —
does he take this verse out for this purpose
phrases.notes: "This purpose" is that a sinner's מנחה is פסול when not done for its sake, from step 14.

phrases.english: and also take it out for that purpose?!
phrases.notes: "That purpose" is the right-hand and vessel rule from step 17.

steps.triggerLanguage: הַאי קְרָא מַפֵּיק לֵיהּ לְהָכִי וּמַפֵּיק לֵיהּ לְהָכִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the use of the verse for רבי שמעון's lesson in step 17
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי שמעון's use of the comparison for the hand and vessel rule
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: One comparison cannot teach both the שלא לשמה rule and the hand and vessel rule

steps.title: The verse is for the hand rule, and the sinner's מנחה comes from "היא"
steps.stepSummary: The verse mainly teaches רב יהודה בריה דרבי חייא's lesson. The sinner's מנחה is פסול שלא לשמה because the word "היא" is written about it, just as it is about a חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: The main purpose of the verse is to teach what רב יהודה בריה דרבי חייא said. The fact that a sinner's מנחה is פסול when not done for its sake comes from a different reason. Why is a חטאת פסול? Because "היא" is written about it. "היא" is also written about a sinner's מנחה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבי שמעון does not learn both lessons from the comparison. He learns only the hand and vessel rule from it, and gets the sinner's מנחה rule from a different word.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A חטאת שלא לשמה is פסול because the תורה says "היא", meaning it must be exactly a חטאת. The same word "היא" appears about the sinner's מנחה, so the same rule applies there. That frees the comparison to teach only רב יהודה בריה דרבי חייא's lesson.

keyTerms.meaning: The main purpose of the verse
A different reason
"It", a word showing the offering must stay exactly what it is
A sinner's מנחה, brought for a sin

steps.whatToRemember: For רבי שמעון, the comparison teaches the hand and vessel rule. The sinner's מנחה is פסול שלא לשמה because of the word "היא".

phrases.english: The main purpose of the verse —

phrases.aramaic: לְכִדְרַב יְהוּדָה בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי חִיָּיא הוּא דַּאֲתָא;
phrases.english: is to come for the lesson of Rav Yehuda son of Rabbi Chiya;
and a sinner's meal offering being unfit when not done for its sake
— that is a different reason:
phrases.notes: The words in square brackets are the corrected wording.

phrases.english: A sin offering, what is the reason it is unfit?
Because "it" is written about it;
phrases.notes: ויקרא 4:24

phrases.english: A sinner's meal offering also
has "it" written about it.
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:11

steps.triggerLanguage: עִיקָּר קְרָא לְכִדְרַב יְהוּדָה בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי חִיָּיא הוּא דַּאֲתָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 18
steps.terutzResolutionType: Different source for one of the two laws
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Both laws seemed to come from the one comparison
steps.terutzMaskana: The comparison teaches only the hand and vessel rule. The sinner's מנחה rule comes from the word "היא".

steps.title: What do the רבנן learn from comparing אשם to חטאת?
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן hold an אשם שלא לשמו is כשר, so the גמרא asks what lesson they learn from the verse comparing אשם to חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to the רבנן, for what law is an אשם compared to a חטאת?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the verse רבי אליעזר used in the משנה. It asks what the רבנן, who disagree with him, learn from it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר used "כחטאת כאשם" to prove that an אשם שלא לשמו is פסול like a חטאת. The רבנן say an אשם שלא לשמו is כשר, so they cannot use the verse that way. The גמרא wants to know what the comparison teaches them.

keyTerms.meaning: For what law?
Was compared, linked by the תורה
The Sages, the majority opinion

phrases.english: And according to the Rabbis,
for what law
is a guilt offering compared to a sin offering?
phrases.notes: ויקרא 7:7, the verse רבי אליעזר quoted in the משנה.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּלְרַבָּנַן לְמַאי הִלְכְתָא אִיתַּקַּשׁ אָשָׁם לְחַטָּאת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from רבי שמעון back to the רבנן and the verse in the משנה
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the comparison of אשם to חטאת teaches according to the רבנן

steps.title: The comparison teaches that an אשם needs סמיכה
steps.stepSummary: The comparison teaches that an אשם needs סמיכה, just like a חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: To tell you: just as a חטאת needs סמיכה, so too an אשם needs סמיכה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that for the רבנן, the comparison teaches the law of סמיכה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The רבנן don't learn the שלא לשמה rule from the comparison, so they use it for a different law. A חטאת needs the owner to lean his hands on the animal, and the verse teaches that an אשם needs this too.

keyTerms.meaning: Leaning one's hands on the head of the animal before it is slaughtered
Requires
To tell you

steps.whatToRemember: For the רבנן, "כחטאת כאשם" teaches סמיכה, not that an אשם שלא לשמו is פסול.

phrases.english: To tell you:
just as a sin offering requires placing hands,
so too a guilt offering requires placing hands.

steps.triggerLanguage: לוֹמַר לָךְ מָה חַטָּאת טְעוּנָה סְמִיכָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 20
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The comparison teaches that an אשם requires סמיכה like a חטאת

steps.title: רבי יוחנן links יוסף בן חוני with רבי אליעזר
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes יוסף בן חוני's opinion from the משנה, and רבי יוחנן says that יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר hold the same view.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: יוסף בן חוני says, those slaughtered and so on. רבי יוחנן said: יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר said the same thing.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves on to the next opinion in the משנה, יוסף בן חוני. רבי יוחנן says his view is the same as רבי אליעזר's.
steps.deeperAnalysis: יוסף בן חוני says offerings slaughtered for the sake of a פסח or a חטאת are פסול. רבי יוחנן tells us this is not a new, separate opinion, because רבי אליעזר holds the same view. This opens a new discussion about how far their agreement goes.

keyTerms.meaning: A תנא whose opinion is in the משנה
"Etc.", short for the rest of the quote
The same thing

phrases.english: Yosef ben Choni says:
those slaughtered, etc.
phrases.notes: The rest of the משנה: offerings slaughtered for the sake of a פסח or a חטאת are פסול.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yochanan said:
Yosef ben Choni and Rabbi Eliezer,
said the same thing.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן יוֹסֵף בֶּן חוֹנִי וְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אָמְרוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new section on the next opinion in the משנה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר hold the same opinion

steps.title: רבה says they disagree only about offerings slaughtered as a sin offering
steps.stepSummary: רבה says that יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר disagree about other offerings slaughtered for the sake of a חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה said: They disagree about other offerings slaughtered for the sake of a sin offering.
steps.whatsHappening: רבה gives a different view from רבי יוחנן. He says יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר do not fully agree. Their argument is about other offerings slaughtered as a חטאת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן had said the two hold the same view. רבה limits their agreement: both disqualify other offerings slaughtered as a פסח. Only יוסף בן חוני disqualifies other offerings slaughtered as a חטאת, while רבי אליעזר holds them כשר.

keyTerms.meaning: Other offerings (not the kind named)
For the sake of a sin offering
They disagree

phrases.english: Rabba said:
They disagree about other offerings slaughtered for the sake of a sin offering.
phrases.notes: "They" means יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר. About offerings slaughtered as a פסח, they agree.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with רבי יוחנן's claim that the two תנאים hold the same view.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: יוסף בן חוני and רבי אליעזר agree that other offerings slaughtered as a פסח are פסול. They disagree about other offerings slaughtered as a חטאת.

steps.title: The ברייתא shows רבי אליעזר disqualifies other offerings slaughtered as a פסח
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא shows that רבי אליעזר disqualifies a too-old פסח slaughtered as a פסח, and other offerings slaughtered as a פסח at its time. רבי יהושע holds them כשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it is taught: A Paschal offering whose year has passed, and one slaughtered it at its time for its own sake; and likewise one who slaughters other offerings for the sake of a Paschal offering at its time: רבי אליעזר disqualifies, and רבי יהושע declares it fit.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא as support for רבה. It shows that רבי אליעזר disqualifies other offerings slaughtered as a פסח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An animal older than a year cannot be a פסח, so it is treated like other offerings. If it is slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th of ניסן, רבי אליעזר says it is פסול. This matches רבה's claim that רבי אליעזר agrees with יוסף בן חוני about offerings slaughtered as a פסח.

keyTerms.meaning: A פסח animal that is now older than one year
At its proper time (the 14th of ניסן)
Disqualifies
Declares it fit

phrases.english: As it is taught:
A Paschal offering whose year has passed,
and one slaughtered it at its time for its own sake;
and likewise one who slaughters other offerings
for the sake of a Paschal offering at its time:
Rabbi Eliezer disqualifies,
and Rabbi Yehoshua declares it fit.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the source showing רבי אליעזר's view on offerings slaughtered as a פסח.
steps.raayaObject: רבה's claim that רבי אליעזר disqualifies other offerings slaughtered as a פסח
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא where רבי אליעזר disqualifies other offerings slaughtered as a פסח at its time

steps.title: רבי יהושע argues with a קל וחומר that they should be fit
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע argues: during the rest of the year, other offerings slaughtered as a פסח are כשר. On the 14th, when a פסח is even fitting, they should surely be כשר.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said: If during the rest of the days of the year, when it is not fit for its own sake, others are fit for its sake, then at its time, when it is fit for its own sake, isn't it logical that others should be fit for its sake?!
steps.whatsHappening: Inside the ברייתא, רבי יהושע gives a reason for his view. He uses a קל וחומר, an argument from a weaker case to a stronger case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rest of the year, a real פסח slaughtered as a פסח is פסול, yet other offerings slaughtered as a פסח are כשר. On the 14th, a פסח slaughtered as a פסח is כשר. So רבי יהושע says other offerings slaughtered as a פסח should surely be כשר then too.

keyTerms.meaning: An argument from a weaker case to a stronger one
The rest of the days of the year
Isn't it logical? (opens a קל וחומר)

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said:
If during the rest of the days of the year,
when it is not fit for its own sake,
phrases.notes: He means a פסח slaughtered as a פסח on another day is פסול.

phrases.english: others are fit for its sake;
at its time, when it is fit for its own sake,
isn't it logical that others should be fit for its sake?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רבי יהושע's reasoning for declaring it fit in the ברייתא.
steps.raayaObject: רבי יהושע's ruling that other offerings slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th are כשר
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from the rest of the year, when such offerings are כשר

steps.title: רבי אליעזר flips the argument and shows it leads to a wrong result
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר reverses the קל וחומר. That would make a פסח slaughtered for another offering on the 14th כשר, which is wrong. So the reasoning fails.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר said to him: Or the reverse: Just as during the rest of the days of the year, when it is not fit for its own sake, it is fit for the sake of others, then at its time, when it is fit for its own sake, isn't it logical that it should be fit for the sake of others?! Then a Paschal offering on the fourteenth slaughtered not for its own sake would be fit!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר answers רבי יהושע. He builds the same kind of argument in the other direction, and it ends in a result everyone knows is false.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rest of the year, a פסח slaughtered for another offering is כשר. Using רבי יהושע's method, on the 14th it should surely be כשר too. But a פסח slaughtered שלא לשמו on the 14th is פסול, so this kind of קל וחומר cannot be relied on here.

keyTerms.meaning: The reverse of the argument
Not for its own sake (for another offering)
The fourteenth of ניסן, the time of the פסח

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהושע's קל וחומר can be flipped to prove something false, a פסח slaughtered שלא לשמו on the 14th being כשר. That is why רבי אליעזר rejects it and holds other offerings slaughtered as a פסח at its time are פסול.
steps.confusionAlert: רבי אליעזר does not really think a פסח שלא לשמו on the 14th is כשר. He builds that argument only to show that the method gives an impossible answer.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said to him:
Or the reverse:
Just as during the rest of the days of the year,
when it is not fit for its own sake,
it is fit for the sake of others;
phrases.notes: Here "it" is the פסח animal itself, slaughtered as some other offering.

phrases.english: at its time, when it is fit for its own sake,
isn't it logical that it should be fit for the sake of others?!

phrases.aramaic: וְיוּכְשַׁר פֶּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר שֶׁלֹּא לִשְׁמוֹ!
phrases.english: Then a Paschal offering on the fourteenth slaughtered not for its own sake would be fit!

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹ חִילּוּף הַדְּבָרִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רבי יהושע's קל וחומר by reversing it.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole method of רבי יהושע's קל וחומר
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The same reasoning, reversed, would make a פסח slaughtered שלא לשמו on the 14th כשר, which is known to be false.

steps.title: The rest of the year cannot be compared to the 14th
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר attacks the starting point of רבי יהושע's קל וחומר. During the year, the rule works both ways. On the 14th, a פסח slaughtered for another offering is פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: And you would argue like that?! Why should it matter that other offerings slaughtered as a פסח are כשר during the rest of the year? That is because then a פסח slaughtered for another offering is also כשר. But should other offerings slaughtered as a פסח be כשר at its proper time, when a פסח slaughtered for other offerings is פסול?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר gives a second reason why רבי יהושע's קל וחומר fails. He says the rest of the year is a different situation from the 14th of ניסן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: During the year, a פסח slaughtered as another offering is כשר, and other offerings slaughtered as a פסח are also כשר, so the rule is equal both ways. On the 14th, a פסח slaughtered as another offering is פסול. So the year-round case cannot teach anything about the 14th.

keyTerms.meaning: they were made כשר (fit)
during the rest of the days of the year
at its proper time (the 14th of ניסן)
for its sake (here: as a פסח)
for the sake of other offerings

phrases.english: And you would say this?!
What is it to me that other offerings were made fit
phrases.notes: 'Its sake' in the next lines means the פסח. 'Others' means other offerings like שלמים.

phrases.english: during the rest of the days of the year for its sake
since it is fit for the sake of others;
but shall others be made fit at its time for its sake
when it is unfit for the sake of others?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second refutation of רבי יהושע's קל וחומר, following the reversal in step 26.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The base case of רבי יהושע's קל וחומר.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The year-round case is equal in both directions, but the 14th is not. So the year-round case cannot serve as a base for a קל וחומר about the 14th.

steps.title: Your view makes the שלמים stronger than the פסח
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע objects that רבי אליעזר's view weakens the פסח and strengthens the שלמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהושע said to him: If so, you have weakened the power of the פסח and given power to the שלמים.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע pushes back on רבי אליעזר. He says רבי אליעזר's position leads to a strange result.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Under רבי אליעזר's view, a פסח slaughtered as a שלמים during the year is כשר. But a שלמים slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th is פסול. That means a שלמים keeps its identity more strongly than a פסח does, which seems backwards.

keyTerms.meaning: you have weakened the power
you have given power (strengthened)
peace offerings

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him:
If so, you have weakened the power of the Pesach,
phrases.notes: He means: by your rule, a שלמים slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th is פסול, while a פסח slaughtered as a שלמים during the year is כשר.

phrases.english: and you have given power to the peace offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם כֵּן הוֹרַעְתָּה כֹּחַ פֶּסַח
steps.relationToPreviousStep: רבי יהושע responds to רבי אליעזר's refutation by attacking the result of his position.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר's ruling that other offerings slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th are פסול.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: That ruling gives the שלמים a stronger hold on its identity than the פסח has, which seems backwards.

steps.title: A leftover פסח becomes a שלמים, but not the other way
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר sets up a new argument. A leftover פסח is brought as a שלמים, but a leftover שלמים is never brought as a פסח.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר went back and argued a different inference: We find that a leftover פסח is brought as a שלמים, but a leftover שלמים is not brought as a פסח.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר starts a brand-new line of reasoning. Here he only lays down the basic fact that the next step will build on.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An animal set aside as a פסח that is not used goes on to be offered as a שלמים. A שלמים can never turn into a פסח. This shows the פסח can easily 'become' a שלמים, so it is the less fixed offering of the two.

keyTerms.meaning: went back (started again)
argued another logical inference
we find
a leftover פסח (an animal set aside but not offered as a פסח)

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer went back
and argued another inference to him:
We find that a leftover Pesach is brought as a peace offering,
but a leftover peace offering is not brought as a Pesach.

steps.triggerLanguage: חָזַר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְדָנוֹ דִּין אַחֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After רבי יהושע's objection, רבי אליעזר opens a new argument for his position.
steps.raayaObject: רבי אליעזר's ruling that other offerings slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th are פסול.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The law of a leftover פסח, which is brought as a שלמים, while a leftover שלמים is never brought as a פסח.

steps.title: So a שלמים slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th is surely פסול
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר completes his קל וחומר. A פסח slaughtered as a שלמים on the 14th is פסול, even though a פסח can become a שלמים. So a שלמים slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th must surely be פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: A פסח can have its leftover brought as a שלמים, and still, if one slaughtered it at its time as a שלמים, it is פסול. A שלמים can never have its leftover brought as a פסח. So if one slaughtered it as a פסח at the פסח's time, isn't it logical that it should be פסול?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר finishes the new קל וחומר he set up in the last step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A פסח is close to being a שלמים, yet slaughtering it as a שלמים on the 14th still ruins it. A שלמים has no connection to becoming a פסח, so slaughtering it as a פסח on the 14th should ruin it even more.

keyTerms.meaning: and just as (the opening word of a קל וחומר)
isn't it logical?
unfit (disqualified)

steps.whatToRemember: רבי אליעזר's final argument: the פסח can become a שלמים and is still פסול if slaughtered as a שלמים on the 14th. So a שלמים slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th is surely פסול.

phrases.english: And just as a Pesach, whose leftover is brought as a peace offering —
if one slaughtered it at its time as a peace offering, it is unfit;
peace offerings, whose leftover is not brought as a Pesach —
if one slaughtered them as a Pesach at its time,
isn't it logical that they should be unfit?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the קל וחומר built on the fact stated in step 29.
steps.raayaObject: Other offerings slaughtered as a פסח on the 14th are פסול.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from a פסח slaughtered as a שלמים on the 14th, which is פסול even though a leftover פסח can be brought as a שלמים.
